descriptionHtml:
Candidate N5 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Pre-Round Save Note changes medication rows that were only restated as continuing: adds reasons, flips a Changed warfarin row to active, renames 'Heparin drip' to 'Heparin drip 14' tagged Changed

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local

Note: Dev, live Haiku: pool 4/10 (gate 9/10); the encounter path left every row unchanged. H-05's unit half is B07.

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S09 AI Check 1: no medication change dictated → no row added or changed (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U16 AI Check: when no medication change is dictated, no row is added or changed. At least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted. (UAT TC-19 AI Check; UAT 3.2)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status. (UAT TC-19 ER 2; TFA-92597 R1)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Ten independent visits, one per class of 'no change': no drug named; continue/keep; repeat hold; conditional restart; labs only; drip rates restated; routine chronic visit; held drug with poor intake restated; PRN described; future plan

When Send each dictation through the encounter path and the pre-round path (both), as the signed-in test physician

Then Every fixture leaves the rows exactly as on file: same names, statuses, tags, dates, reasons and count; no new row

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): check 'unchanged' per fixture (Q11: last-mentioned time ignored); passes at 9/10 or better (3.2), every failure quoted with the rows before and after. H-05 also forbids an invented drip unit, so an added 'units/hr' fails that fixture here and is quoted again with S10's unit findings. …

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S09

AI Check 1: no medication change dictated → no row added or changed (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, dataset meds-s09 (20 charts prefixed QA DS1-meds-s09, deleted after: 20 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed). The ten lane-B fixtures of cases/TC-19.matrix.json S09, each on two charts with its rows on file: the dictation typed into Pre-Round Save Note on one, and into the encounter path on the other (Hospital Encounter Save & Extract; Nursing Home Generate Note & Finish, whose visit extraction is the encounter merge, Q8). Rows read back with rounding:get / snf:get and compared with the rows on file (name, status, changeType, changeDate, changedNote, count; updatedAt ignored, Q11). Pool 4/10 (H-01, H-02, H-04, N-01), needs 9/10: failed. The encounter path left every row exactly as on file on all 10 fixtures; every failure is on the pre-round path: H-03 Furosemide gets reason 'continues'; N-02 Lisinopril gets 'continued at current dose'; N-03 Acetaminophen PRN gets 'as-needed for pain control'; N-05 Potassium chloride gets 'consider stopping at next visit if labs are okay' (a future plan written onto today's row); N-04 Warfarin goes from changed to active and its reason 'dose adjusted for INR' is replaced by 'INR 2.4 today, in range; recheck INR next week'; H-05 'Heparin drip at 14 continues. Diltiazem drip stays at 5' renames the rows to 'Heparin drip 14' / 'Diltiazem drip 5', status changed, tag 'Changed · Oct 15', and the pre-round output carries '14 units' (the unit part is the known B07). The tracker shows any reason under the row (Post-Round with the change mark), so a physician sees changes nobody dictated. Note: the run's own cells counted H-02 as failed only because a reason went from none to an empty string; it was re-judged from the stored rows with empty = none (TC-19-S09.rejudged.json), which does not change the verdict.

Product issue: When a physician only restates current medications in the pre-round note ('Furosemide continues', 'Keep lisinopril at 20', 'Continue warfarin', 'Heparin drip at 14 continues'), Save Note writes new reasons onto those rows ('continues', 'continued at current dose', a future plan), replaces an older change reason, flips a Changed warfarin row to active, and even renames drips to 'Heparin drip 14' / 'Diltiazem drip 5' with a 'Changed · today' tag. The Medications panel and the Post-Round tracker then show changes that were never dictated (U16 / U4: continue is not an event). The encounter path (Save & Extract, Nursing Home visit) did not do this.

Evidence: 3 attached.
